about: Regulator side, shared by every customer. One entry per report: who files it, as a deterministic rule where the regulator states one, and the patterns that name it in monitor names and addresses. A report without a rule is decided only by the entity profile (config/profile.json). Thresholds were checked against each source on verified_at; regmon/applicability.py reads this file, and the dashboard reads the same rules.

slhc.label: Savings and loan holding company
slhc.noun: a savings and loan holding company

ihc.label: U.S. intermediate holding company of a foreign bank

fbo_branch.label: U.S. branch or agency of a foreign bank
fbo_branch.noun: a U.S. branch or agency of a foreign bank

ca_trust_loan.label: Federally regulated trust or loan company (Canada)
ca_trust_loan.noun: a federally regulated trust or loan company

ca_fbb.label: Foreign bank branch (Canada)
ca_fbb.noun: a foreign bank branch in Canada

reports.name: Basel Capital Adequacy Reporting (BCAR, return BA)
reports.who_files: All deposit-taking institutions except foreign bank branches: banks (including federal credit unions), bank holding companies and federally regulated trust and loan companies.

reports.name: Report of Assets and Liabilities of U.S. Branches and Agencies of Foreign Banks
reports.who_files: U.S. branches and agencies of foreign banks.

reports.name: Report of Assets and Liabilities of a Non-U.S. Branch that is Managed or Controlled by a U.S. Branch or Agency of a Foreign Bank
reports.who_files: U.S. branches and agencies of foreign banks, for each non-U.S. branch they manage or control.

reports.name: Country Exposure Report
reports.who_files: U.S. banks and holding companies above the report's foreign-claims threshold. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Country Exposure Information Report
reports.who_files: Filers of the FFIEC 009 with exposures above the disclosure thresholds. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Country Exposure Report for U.S. Branches and Agencies of Foreign Banks
reports.who_files: U.S. branches and agencies of foreign banks above the report's exposure threshold. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Foreign Branch Report of Condition
reports.who_files: U.S. banks for each significant foreign branch. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Abbreviated Foreign Branch Report of Condition
reports.who_files: U.S. banks for each smaller foreign branch. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Call Report: bank with domestic and foreign offices
reports.who_files: Banks with foreign offices, banks with total consolidated assets of $100 billion or more, and advanced approaches institutions regardless of size.

reports.name: Call Report: bank with domestic offices only
reports.who_files: Banks with domestic offices only and total consolidated assets of less than $100 billion (not advanced approaches institutions). A bank eligible for the FFIEC 051 may file the FFIEC 041 instead.

reports.name: Call Report: bank with domestic offices only and total assets under $5 billion
reports.who_files: Banks with domestic offices only and total assets of less than $5 billion may file it, except advanced approaches institutions and those subject to Category III standards. Eligible banks may file the FFIEC 041 instead.

reports.name: Regulatory Capital Reporting for Institutions Subject to the Advanced Capital Adequacy Framework
reports.who_files: Advanced approaches institutions file the full report; top-tier Category III institutions (and all Category III IHCs) complete only Schedule A, SLR Tables 1 and 2.

reports.name: Market Risk Regulatory Report
reports.who_files: Institutions subject to the market risk capital rule: aggregate trading assets and trading liabilities of $1 billion or more, or 10 percent or more of quarter-end total assets.

reports.name: Government Securities Dealers Reports (FR 2004 series)
reports.regulator: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
reports.who_files: Primary dealers in U.S. government securities. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Survey of Terms of Lending (FR 2028 series)
reports.who_files: A sample of banks selected by the Federal Reserve. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Complex Institution Liquidity Monitoring Report
reports.who_files: Banking organizations subject to Category I, II, III or IV standards; daily or monthly by category and weighted short-term wholesale funding.

reports.name: Report of Selected Money Market Rates (FR 2420 series)
reports.who_files: Banks and agencies selected by the Federal Reserve. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Semiannual Report of Derivatives Activity
reports.who_files: A voluntary panel of eight of the largest U.S. dealers of OTC derivatives. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Report of Selected Assets and Liabilities of Domestically Chartered Commercial Banks and U.S. Branches and Agencies of Foreign Banks
reports.who_files: A voluntary random stratified sample of about 850 domestically chartered commercial banks, and U.S. branches and agencies of foreign banks. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Quarterly Report of Interest Rates on Selected Direct Consumer Installment Loans (FR 2835 series)
reports.who_files: A sample of commercial banks. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Report of Deposits and Vault Cash
reports.who_files: Depository institutions above the deposit reporting threshold the Board sets each year, and all banking Edge and agreement corporations and U.S. branches and agencies of foreign banks. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Regulation VV Quantitative Measurements
reports.who_files: BHCs and FBOs whose average gross trading assets and liabilities over the prior four quarters (excluding U.S. government and agency obligations) are $20 billion or more.

reports.name: Report of Changes in Organizational Structure
reports.who_files: Top-tier BHCs and SLHCs, securities holding companies and FBOs, within 30 days of a reportable event; also state member banks and Edge corporations not controlled by a BHC or FBO.

reports.name: Financial Statements of U.S. Nonbank Subsidiaries of U.S. Holding Companies
reports.who_files: Top-tier holding companies that file the FR Y-9C, for each nonbank subsidiary above the size and activity thresholds in the instructions (quarterly at $1 billion or more; annually from $500 million; FR Y-11S from $250 million).

reports.name: Consolidated Holding Company Report of Equity Investments in Nonfinancial Companies
reports.who_files: Top-tier domestic holding companies that file the FR Y-9C or FR Y-9SP and meet the reporting requirements in the instructions.

reports.name: Capital Assessments and Stress Testing (annual)
reports.who_files: Top-tier BHCs, covered SLHCs and IHCs with total consolidated assets of $100 billion or more.

reports.name: Capital Assessments and Stress Testing (monthly)
reports.who_files: Top-tier BHCs, covered SLHCs and IHCs with total consolidated assets of $100 billion or more.

reports.name: Capital Assessments and Stress Testing (quarterly)
reports.who_files: Top-tier BHCs, covered SLHCs and IHCs with total consolidated assets of $100 billion or more.

reports.name: Banking Organization Systemic Risk Report
reports.who_files: Top-tier BHCs, covered SLHCs and IHCs with total consolidated assets of $100 billion or more.

reports.name: Annual Report of Holding Companies
reports.who_files: U.S.-organized top-tier holding companies (including ESOPs that are holding companies) and securities holding companies; certain foreign-organized holding companies and FBOs as the instructions set out.

reports.name: Annual Report of Foreign Banking Organizations
reports.who_files: Foreign banking organizations doing business in the United States through a subsidiary bank, an Edge or agreement corporation, a commercial lending company, or a branch or agency.

reports.name: Capital and Asset Report for Foreign Banking Organizations
reports.who_files: Foreign banking organizations with U.S. operations (subsidiary bank, Edge or agreement corporation, commercial lending company, branch or agency), quarterly or annually.

reports.name: Holding Company Report of Insured Depository Institutions' Section 23A Transactions with Affiliates
reports.who_files: Top-tier U.S. bank holding companies, intermediate holding companies, savings and loan holding companies, and FBOs that directly own a U.S. subsidiary bank.

reports.name: Consolidated Financial Statements for Holding Companies
reports.who_files: Holding companies (BHCs, SLHCs, IHCs and SHCs) with total consolidated assets of $3 billion or more; only the top-tier holding company files.
reports.note: Holding companies meeting certain other criteria file regardless of size.

reports.name: Financial Statements for Employee Stock Ownership Plan Holding Companies
reports.who_files: All ESOP bank holding companies and ESOP savings and loan holding companies. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Parent Company Only Financial Statements for Large Holding Companies
reports.who_files: Each holding company that files the FR Y-9C submits the FR Y-9LP for its parent company.

reports.name: Parent Company Only Financial Statements for Small Holding Companies
reports.who_files: Holding companies with total consolidated assets of less than $3 billion, semiannually.

reports.name: Treasury Foreign Currency reports
reports.regulator: U.S. Treasury / Federal Reserve Bank of New York
reports.who_files: U.S. resident institutions above the foreign currency reports' thresholds. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.

reports.name: Treasury International Capital reports
reports.regulator: U.S. Treasury / Federal Reserve Bank of New York
reports.who_files: U.S. resident financial institutions and others above each TIC form's reporting threshold. Not decided by rule: list it in the profile.
